title: Legitimate payment blocked because the untrusted memo contained non-ASCII text
discoveredBy: smoke run of the holdout generator on a DEV seed ('dev-only-not-the-eval') before freezing; case H0046 mutation memo_unicode
integrityNote: Because this was found with the holdout grammar (dev seed), knowledge of the memo_unicode mutation leaked into development. The frozen evaluation uses a different seed but the same grammar; this is reported as a limitation.
rootCause: PROPOSE required printable-ASCII memo although the memo is free text that never influences an authorization decision and is never signed.
patch: Accept any memo <= 280 UTF-16 units without control characters; store it ASCII-escaped. Recipient/amount/asset/capability validation unchanged.
